newsitem.title: GERMANY: Summary of Ifo Nov German business survey.
newsitem.headline: Summary of Ifo Nov German business survey.

text.p: Following is a summary of key points in the IFO economic research institute's monthly business survey for November (sectors are west German unless otherwise stated, comparisons are against pvs month):
Ifo said on Monday that its business climate index fell to 96.9 in November from a revised 97.3 in October.
Business outlook - only slightly less optimistic
Current business - still improving, but on balance negative
Export outlook - main source of hopes
Note - In chemicals situation seen as satisfactory, but not as good as in October; metals -- more optimistic; pulp and paper -- barely satisfactory; textiles -- higher demand and good prospects.
Current business - no continuation of improvement
Business outlook - uptrend to be interrupted
Orders level - dampened by slower demand and increased output
Note - In machine-building situation improved slightly, but order books seen too low; electricals -- export outlook less promising; vehicles -- satisfactory situation seen improving;
Note - Carmakers said orders down but exports remain supportive; electronics -- current situation worsening, output plans trimmed; precision mechanical/optical -- worse again.
Business outlook - not as bad as earlier this year
Note - Clothing sector current business and outlook both improving; shoes -- less pessimistic; consumer textiles -- much better.
Orders level - 2.8 months output, up on year ago
Current business - output significantly down on October
Current business - turnover down despite longer store hours
Current business - improving after October setback
Personnel plans - two percent job cuts expected
